id: extra:Debian runtime and build image packages
name: Debian runtime and build image packages
note: Base images and apt-installed libraries have individual licenses under /usr/share/doc/*/copyright and /usr/share/common-licenses. Source-level dependency scanning is not a complete OS-image inventory. Preserve these notices and arrange corresponding source for redistributed GPL/LGPL packages. Exact apt versions are not snapshot-pinned; audit each built release image.

name: Alpine runtime image packages
version: Image digest pins in Dockerfiles / Compose
note: The nginx and Bun image families and other service images include independent OS and native dependencies. Their package licenses and corresponding source are separate from the nginx/Bun project license. Audit the actual release images, including BusyBox/musl/OpenSSL where present.

name: Linux desktop libraries
note: Linux plugins link to host GTK/GLib/libsecret libraries. Host installations are not bundled by this repository, but Linux installers or container distributions that include them must retain their notices and satisfy applicable LGPL obligations.

name: CUDA runtime components
note: Ollama MIT terms do not replace the terms for CUDA runtime components. Redistribution is limited to permitted redistributables and is subject to the actual CUDA version terms. The exact image-specific GPU bundle has not been cleared by this source inventory.

name: ROCm runtime components
note: ROCm images contain multiple projects and may include separately licensed runtime or firmware components. Audit the exact digest image before distribution; no complete binary inventory is claimed here.

name: Chrome for Testing / ChromeDriver
license: Chromium licenses and Google Chrome terms
note: Downloaded only for tests by scripts/testing/browser/browser-tools.ts. Chrome binaries have terms distinct from the Chromium source license. Do not assume redistribution rights from BSD-licensed Chromium components. They are not copied into Domabas release images by its Dockerfiles.

name: Android SDK
note: The SDK is a development prerequisite with separate terms, including limits on redistributing SDK components. Building a commercial application is distinct from shipping the SDK. It is not part of the application license inventory.

name: Apple SDKs and platform frameworks
note: iOS and macOS require Apple tooling and platform frameworks. Their platform/distribution agreements are separate from open-source dependency licenses. No Apple SDK is redistributed by this repository.

name: Gradle
note: Gradle wrapper resolves the pinned distribution; its bundled dependencies carry additional notices.

name: Kotlin Gradle plugin
note: Android build plugin dependency; additional Kotlin runtime components appear in the Android inventory.

name: OpenJDK / Temurin
note: Java is a build/generator prerequisite, not bundled in the Flutter app or Go executables. The exception and separate bundled-component notices matter if redistributing a JDK.

name: Go Task
note: Go Task is a host-installed command runner and is not shipped in the application.
